Volunteer, Africa Maths Initiative

Education

I work mainly as a volunteer with the Africa Maths Initiative (AMI). At each camp I create hands-on, gamified maths lessons and facilitate them with learners. I also help measure what the camps achieve. The team has run 26 camps since 2022.

Camps I have taken part in

  • STEM BootCamp with Project InspireArusha
  • Kongoni Community Library campLikuyani, KakamegaTwice
  • Nyahera Girls High SchoolHoma Bay
  • Nyarongi community maths campNyarongiTwice
  • Rombo Girls High SchoolOloitokitok
  • Good Shepherd Minor SeminaryMarala, Samburu
  • And othersAcross East Africa

My contribution

  • Created and facilitated hands-on, gamified maths lessons
  • Designed data collection tools for baseline and endline studies
  • Analysed the data and contributed to camp reports
  • Presented the AMI camps at the AFRICME7 conference, Johannesburg

Documentation

  • Kenya Math Camp Report, May 2023 (Kongoni Community Library)
  • Nyahera Girls' Math Camp feature by SAMI, November 2023

Outputs

  • Two co-authored papers on maths camps
  • AFRICME7 proceedings paper on 21 maths camps

Kenya Agroecology Hub partnership

Agriculture

In collaboration with the Kenya Agroecology Hub, I support Farmer Research Networks (FRNs) and CRFS grantees in western Kenya. I have directly supported 10 partner organisations working in agroecology.

Where it started

I started this work with a six month pilot in Kuria West, Kenya, testing whether school-going pupils could help farmers record data while improving their own learning. Read the pilot report →

Farmer-led research I have supported

  • Termite FRN2025/26Farmer-led trials on termite management, with a KoboToolbox pipeline and a Shiny dashboard and map
  • Socio-cultural barriers to agroecology uptakeFarmer research into what holds back adoption of agroecological practices
  • Fermented feeds FRNFarmer-led fermented feed trials with lab nutrient analysis and a results dashboardView the lab results →
  • Improving farmer training on agroecology practices through collaboration and follow-up2026Kenya Agroecology Hub joint learning activity for the 10 Community of Practice members. Endline covered 223 farmers in 42 sub-counties; I co-authored the Field Assessment Report.Read the report →

Funded by

CRFS (McKnight Foundation)Agroecology FundConservation Food and Health Foundation

My role in each study

  • Designing data collection tools in KoboCollect
  • Training data collectors
  • Preparing field protocols
  • Data cleaning and analysis
  • Creating dashboards in Python, Excel and R Shiny

Documentation

  • Agroecology planning workshop documentation, Kitale, August 2025
  • Field Assessment Report: Improving Farmer Training on AE Practices

Global Parenting Initiative

Parenting Initiative

I supported the ParentApp for Teens randomised controlled trial in Mwanza, Tanzania, part of the Global Parenting Initiative, working in collaboration with the National Institute for Medical Research (NIMR), Mwanza Centre. My engagement lasted three months.

My contribution

  • Supported the field team to obtain consent forms from caregivers
  • Followed up with participants and documented the challenges they had using the ParentApp on their phones
  • Resolved problems where possible so participants could keep taking part
Research partner

National Institute for Medical Research

Mwanza Centre, Tanzania

The ParentApp for Teens trial was carried out in collaboration with NIMR.
